summary: Executed backend pytest and frontend Playwright regression for legal/resources/SEO/waitlist/mobile/demo/use-case/public SEO files on external preview URL.
action_items: Add data-testid attributes for the two interactive mailto links in LegalPage legal-help block (legal@acoord.co and privacy@acoord.co) to satisfy full testability requirement.
critical_code_review_comments: New legal page interactive links in the legal-help section are missing data-testid attributes, which breaks the stated testability standard for critical user-facing interactions.
seed_data_creation: Created unique waitlist submissions via external POST /api/waitlist during UI/API regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core requested routes and integrations passed: Calendly links, all legal/resource/article routes, waitlist consent flow, demo + 10 use-case routes, robots/sitemap/llms reachability, SEO metadata updates, and mobile overflow checks. Only outstanding gap observed is missing data-testid on 2 legal help mailto links.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open /legal/privacy and inspect legal-help mailto links; both are interactive anchors without data-testid. Root cause: LegalPage component adds data-testid to structural sections but not the two legal-help contact links. Mitigation: add descriptive data-testid attributes to those anchors.
